Subject: BlueHorizon onboarding - PO request and forms attached

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the walkthrough today. Attaching our vendor onboarding packet and the preliminary line item spreadsheet for the first month of usage. We need a PO number to complete our internal finance routing.

Quick notes:
- The onboarding form (first attachment) has our company address and billing contact but the tax ID field was left blank on the export — apologies if that broke anything.
- The CSV includes three line items: base service, reserved capacity uplift, and initial implementation hours. We flagged the uplift as "Estimate" for now.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether we can get an interim PO to allow billings to start while you finish any internal validation?
2) If spend caps are required on your side for new vendors, what level is typical for a partner of our size?

Attachments: BlueHorizon_Onboarding_Form.pdf, BH_lineitems_v1.csv

Best,

Hi Elaine — appreciate the packet. Quick read-through and a couple of asks before I can push a PO number:

- The onboarding form did come through but the Tax ID/EIN is missing. Our procurement system requires either the EIN or a W-9 scanned copy for US entities. Could you send that?
- The CSV layout is fine but the second line (reserved capacity uplift) doesn’t have a firm price column — right now it’s labeled "TBD". For PO issuance we need numeric values (even provisional ones) per line so the accounting system can reserve budget lines.

Looping in Monica so she can confirm spend-cap policy. Monica — is there a standard provisional cap you want to apply for a new vendor trial, or do we need finance pre-approval?

Thanks,
Markus
Senior Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@bluehorizon.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueHorizon onboarding - PO request and forms attached

Thanks for the heads up, Markus. Action items and policy: 

- Policy: New vendor onboarding typically gets a provisional spend cap of $75,000 for the first 60 days while we validate telemetry and delivery performance. If BlueHorizon expects higher initial spend, we can escalate to finance for a one-time exception.
- Required docs: EIN/W-9 or equivalent, completed onboarding form, and line-itemized prices.

Elaine — if you can provide the EIN and a revised CSV with provisional numbers for the uplift line (even a conservative number) we can issue a provisional PO number within 24–48 business hours. If you need the PO sooner (same day), please confirm you accept the provisional cap of $75k and that you’ll supply the W-9 by EOD tomorrow.

Rishi — tagging you for finance approval rule-of-thumb if BlueHorizon requests >$75k.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Head of Supplier Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@bluehorizon.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueHorizon onboarding - PO request and forms attached

Folks — finalizing from finance side. Elaine: thanks for sending the updated attachments this morning (we received BlueHorizon_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf and BH_lineitems_v1b.csv). I validated the EIN and the CSV now has numeric provisional rates.

We've issued a provisional PO number: PO-50712 (attached PDF stub PO_issued_50712.pdf). Notes:
- Provisional spend cap: $75,000 for first 60 days.
- Line items were normalized: implementation hours are capped at 40 hrs (line 3) and uplift estimate set to $4,500 pending usage telemetry. If actual usage exceeds those amounts we will work with BlueHorizon procurement for an incremental PO or spend-cap increase.
- Accounting has created an internal ledger hold against budget center 320-ProductOps.

Next steps for BlueHorizon:
1) Confirm receipt of PO-50712.
2) Acknowledge the spend cap and implementation-hour cap in writing.
3) Deliver final W-9 to procurement@redwoodinference.com (we have a checklist in the Drive link Monica shared).

Thanks — glad to have BlueHorizon onboarded; Markus will follow up to make sure the billing is routing correctly.

— Rishi
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
